result.instructions: Tools for Trumpia, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many text credits do I have left?"; "Show my distribution lists and how many subscribers each has."; "Find the contact with the email jane@example.com and show which lists they are on.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Trumpia data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run trumpia_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run trumpia_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run trumpia_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. trumpia_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: trumpia_get_credit_balance
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: The account's remaining domestic and international text credits. GET /balance/credit.

tools.name: trumpia_get_request_report
tools.title: Get request status report
tools.description: The outcome of an earlier write request (list/contact/message changes are processed asynchronously). Pass the request_id that the write tool returned; the reply holds the result (for example the new list_id) or says it is still processing or failed. GET /report/{request_id}.

request_id.description: The request_id from a write reply.

tools.name: trumpia_list_lists
tools.title: List distribution lists
tools.description: All distribution lists (id and name). Lists group subscriptions for targeted messages. GET /list.

tools.name: trumpia_get_list
tools.title: Get distribution list
tools.description: One distribution list: display name, description, message frequency and subscription / mobile / email counts. GET /list/{list_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_create_list
tools.title: Create distribution list
tools.description: WRITE: create a distribution list. Trumpia requires disclosing how often subscribers get messages and what for. Returns request_id and list_id. The list name must not contain spaces or special characters. PUT /list.

list_name.description: List name (no spaces or special characters), e.g. GeneralList.

display_name.description: Name subscribers see when they sign up (max 50 characters).

frequency.description: Messages per month subscribers will receive (disclosure required by mobile regulations).

description.description: What the list sends, e.g. 'promo alerts' (max 20 characters).

tools.name: trumpia_update_list
tools.title: Update distribution list
tools.description: WRITE: change a distribution list's name, display name, frequency or description. Only the fields you pass change. POST /list/{list_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscription ids
tools.description: Subscription (contact) ids, newest first. Returns ids only; use trumpia_get_subscription for the details. Pages of 100-10000 ids; next_page is set when a full page came back. GET /subscription.

tools.name: trumpia_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: One subscription (contact): name, email, mobile and landline (with verified flags), list ids, created date and custom data. Contains personal data. GET /subscription/{subscription_id}.

subscription_id.description: Subscription id (from a list or search).

tools.name: trumpia_search_subscriptions
tools.title: Search subscriptions
tools.description: Find subscription ids by email, mobile number, landline, country code, created date, first name or last name; optionally within one list. search_data 'all' returns every subscription that has data of that type. Returns ids; use trumpia_get_subscription for details. GET /subscription/search.

search_data.description: The value to find, or 'all' (every subscription that has data of that type; email, mobile and landline only). For search_type created_date a range is required: 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss~YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss', e.g. '2026-03-01 00:00:00~2026-04-01 00:00:00'.

list_id.description: Limit the search to this distribution list.

tools.name: trumpia_add_subscriptions
tools.title: Add subscriptions
tools.description: WRITE: add contacts to one or more distribution lists (comma-separated list names that already exist). Each contact needs a mobile number, an email or a landline. Only add people who gave express consent to receive messages (TCPA, CAN-SPAM, CTIA rules apply); Trumpia may require a submitted API contract. Returns a request_id; check trumpia_get_request_report. PUT /subscription.

list_names.description: Names of existing distribution lists to add the contacts to.

voice_device.description: Number to reach by voice (US, Canada, Guam, Puerto Rico).

value.description: The value; its format depends on the field type.

tools.name: trumpia_update_subscription
tools.title: Update subscription
tools.description: WRITE: change a contact's name, email, mobile, landline, custom data or list membership. Only the fields you pass change. Returns a request_id. POST /subscription/{subscription_id}.

list_names.description: Existing distribution list names the contact should be added to.

value.description: The value; its format depends on the field type.

tools.name: trumpia_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom data fields
tools.description: All custom data fields (id and name) that can be stored on subscriptions and used as mail-merge values. GET /customdata.

tools.name: trumpia_get_custom_field
tools.title: Get custom data field
tools.description: One custom data field: type, options (allowed values, max length), whether required, and its mail-merge text. GET /customdata/{customdata_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: All mobile keywords with id, keyword and the short or long code. GET /keyword.

tools.name: trumpia_get_keyword
tools.title: Get keyword
tools.description: One mobile keyword in detail: auto-response message, code, alternative messages. GET /keyword/{keyword_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_org_names
tools.title: List organization names
tools.description: Registered organization names as { org_names: [ { org_name_id, name, default } ] } (Trumpia returns a bare array; it is wrapped). The id can be set as org_name_id on messages. GET /orgname.

tools.name: trumpia_list_email_senders
tools.title: List email sender addresses
tools.description: Registered email sender addresses (the From / Reply-To addresses allowed for email messages) as { senders: [ { sender_id, address, default } ] } (Trumpia returns a bare array; it is wrapped). GET /email/sender.

tools.name: trumpia_get_message
tools.title: Get message statistics
tools.description: Delivery statistics of a message sent with trumpia_send_message: status (sent / scheduled / canceled), totals, sent and failed counts per channel and credits used. GET /message/{message_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_scheduled_messages
tools.title: List scheduled messages
tools.description: Messages that are scheduled and not yet sent (id, description, scheduled time, recipient counts). Use offset and limit to page; total_count says how many exist. GET /message/scheduled.

tools.name: trumpia_send_message
tools.title: Send message
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS REAL MESSAGES that spend credits and cannot be recalled once sent: send an SMS and/or an email to distribution lists or specific subscriptions, now or scheduled (a scheduled one can be cancelled with trumpia_cancel_scheduled_message). Subscribers must have opted in (TCPA, CAN-SPAM, CTIA). Confirm the recipients and text with the user first. Mail merge tokens: [$FirstName], [$LastName], [$FullName], [$CustomData-NAME]. Returns request_id and message_id. PUT /message.

recipient_type.description: Whether recipient_ids are distribution list ids or subscription ids.

items.description: Numeric id, as returned by Trumpia.

sms.description: SMS text (140 bytes per segment in US/Canada, up to 980 bytes concatenated).

org_name_id.description: Organization name id to include in the mobile message (default organization name if omitted).

send_date.description: Schedule time as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss (24-hour clock; the account's time zone). Omit to send immediately.

mail_merge_first_name.description: Replacement when a contact has no first name.

mail_merge_last_name.description: Replacement when a contact has no last name.

mail_merge_full_name.description: Replacement when a contact has no full name.

tools.name: trumpia_send_sms
tools.title: Send direct SMS
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS A REAL TEXT that spends a credit and cannot be recalled: one SMS to one mobile number without adding the contact first. The recipient must have consented; Trumpia may require API Certification for contacts that have not opted in. Confirm number and text with the user first. Returns request_id and sms_id. PUT /sms.

mobile_number.description: US: the 10-digit number without leading 0 or 1. With country_code 0 the number must be E.164 with a leading +, e.g. +17774443210.

country_code.description: Country code (default 1). 0 = infer it from the number, which then must start with +.

message.description: The text (the SMS header and footer count toward the length).

sender.description: Short/long code or registered landline to send from (default: the account's code).

org_name_id.description: Organization name id (default organization name if omitted).

tools.name: trumpia_cancel_scheduled_message
tools.title: Cancel scheduled message
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a message that is scheduled and has not been sent yet (see trumpia_list_scheduled_messages). Does nothing for a message already sent. DELETE /message/scheduled/{message_id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Trumpia
prompts.description: What you can do with Trumpia here, with example requests to try.
